jobs.label: Радужное плато
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: highly detailed IRIDESCENT CRYSTAL LANDSCAPE, isolated on a genuine transparent PNG background, for compositing other design elements on top.
Input image 1: the user's crystal terrain reference, for the translucent crystalline material, angular landscape concept and luminous quality. Create a NEW landscape composition with substantially MORE GEOMETRIC AND MATERIAL DETAIL, and dramatically stronger iridescence than the reference. Do not reproduce its blue background or exact arrangement.

Material priority: authentic luminous translucent aura-quartz / opalescent dichroic crystal. Prominent thin-film interference colors and prismatic internal reflections that shift across facets: electric cyan and teal, violet, pink/magenta, soft amber and gold. Spectral color follows viewing angle, facet orientation and thickness, alternating with clearer milky lavender crystal areas. Clearly visibly IRIDESCENT, with rich jewel-like color separation, not merely pale lavender tint, not colored painted rock, not metallic chrome. Preserve transparent crystalline depth and subtle cloudy inclusions.

Detail priority: sophisticated detail at several scales. Large usable polygonal top surfaces coexist with many secondary fractured facets, thin stepped cleavage planes, delicate growth striations, tiny chipped bevels and splintered edges. Visible internal stress cracks and refractive layers, finely etched face textures, small intergrown angular crystals along some seams. Intricate local specular highlights and tiny prismatic flashes, all sharp and resolved. Use natural variations in facet size and irregularities instead of a simplistic low-poly mesh of a few large triangles. No uniform glitter grain, no random noise overlay, no blur hiding the details. Fine details should remain legible on close inspection.

Composition priority: wide 3:2 landscape canvas. Terrain occupies the lower roughly 60–65% of the frame, peaks mostly below the upper third, generous transparent space above. The connected ground extends OUT OF FRAME through the bottom and both side edges. The entire bottom border is covered by foreground crystal. Low oblique camera shows enough top surface for standing design objects. No floating island, visible underside or separate podium. Angular faceted skyline, sharp irregular broken edges, strong spatial depth. Keep broad quiet landing areas despite the added detail.
Lighting: high-end sharp studio CGI, broad luminous key light plus controlled edge light revealing the internal structure and spectral reflections; dimensional shadows without crushing the crystal into darkness. Control exposure to retain detail in highlights.
Background: actual alpha transparency outside the terrain, not black, white, blue or a simulated transparency grid. No external colored glow, fog or backdrop. No text, symbols, letters, objects, vegetation or buildings. No rounded dunes or inflated blobs. Only the crystalline terrain.

This variant's composition:
A spacious low plateau sweeps across the foreground. A complex asymmetric cluster of fractured ridges rises toward the rear LEFT; the skyline descends unevenly to the right. Fine sheets and tiny crystal intergrowths occur along the plateau's angular fracture seams. Large clear lilac faces transition to saturated cyan, pink and gold interference colors at oblique angles. Broad landing surface in the lower-right center.
